name: replay-preview
title: ReplayPreview
description: An rrweb session replay in a browser frame: a URL bar that follows the recording, play/pause, a scrubber with click, error, failed-request and navigation markers, speed, fullscreen, Console and Network buttons that open a DevTools panel cut at the playhead (requests, failures, errors), a drawn cursor with click ripples, and a skeleton poster while the player loads.
